policy: All x86 references are exact-build evidence. The snapshot address identity is structural storage evidence only. A +0x100 object access is not called DeferredLight unless its producer/consumer dataflow is independently tied to the D1 TFX extern block. Joint +0x40/+0xC0/+0x100 access is ranked because those byte offsets are independently proven by the D1 retail TFX VM.
